{"consolidated_memory":"infra/k8s/deployment.yaml crash loop issues - two separate occasions

OCCASION 1 - [2026-03-05]
File: infra/k8s/deployment.yaml (infrastructure side)
Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Problem: crash loop in deployment; container restarting a few seconds after start
Root cause: off-by-one error in the slice bound
Fix: corrected the slice bound; added property test around it
PR: #2068 on branch fix/crash-loop-1
Reproduction: roll out to small node pool
Stack: YAML
Covering checks: manifest lint and dry run in CI
Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 80 days running

OCCASION 2 - [2026-04-11]
File: infra/k8s/deployment.yaml (infrastructure side)
Trigger: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
Problem: crash loop in deployment; container restarting a few seconds after start
Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
Fix: moved arithmetic to integer minor units
PR: #9179 on branch fix/crash-loop-3
Reproduction: roll out to small node pool
Stack: YAML
Covering checks: manifest lint and dry run in CI
Result: job finished in 13 minutes instead of 6 hours (previously 6 hours)"}
